name: uart_rx_resync
description: UART receive, 8N1 at 20 clocks per bit on in0 (uio5), entirely in the lane core: the start edge starts timer0 and the coded shifter; every timer0 tick samples (start, 8 data bits LSB first, stop); the shifter's stop pulse stops timer0. timer0 in resync mode moves its count to the bit phase on every falling edge of the line (at most 8 clocks per edge), so samples stay mid-bit for a drifting sender. The lane waits for each word, fails on a bad stop bit (status bit 6) and pushes the byte.
notes: sample_first and sample_phase are the bit's centre clock, (period - 1) // 2 after the edge; the compiler subtracts the contract's edge-to-sample offset (lane_core.edge_to_sample_cycles, measured by the RTL lane-core test) to get the timer counts.
